ShipmondoAPIKeyCredential.title: Shipmondo API Key
ShipmondoAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Copy your API user and API key from Shipmondo Settings → Integrations → API. Use production credentials. NoClick sends them with HTTP Basic authentication to app.shipmondo.com.

label_format.description:
Which format the labels should be.

*10x19* is 10 cm x 19 cm

*compact* format returns the smallest label possible.
label_format.title: Label Format

scale_by.description: Scale down the labels by either width or height. Only applicable when label_format: a4_pdf, 10x19_pdf, 10x19_zpl, compact_pdf, compact_zpl
scale_by.title: Scale By

scale_size.description:
Desired scaled length in cm of dimension in "scale_by".If the length is higher or wider than the original labels, the labels will not be scaled.

 Only applicable when label_format: a4_pdf, 10x19_pdf, 10x19_zpl, compact_pdf, compact_zpl.
scale_size.title: Scale Size

label_dpi.description: Resolution (dots per inch) to return the ZPL label at. If it differs from the resolution the label was originally created at, the ZPL is converted to this resolution. Only applicable when label_format: zpl, 10x19_zpl, compact_zpl.
label_dpi.title: Label Dpi
